goal: FG-620: Add the isolated pilot bootstrap and Python boundary

components.summary: Install and check the packaged skill, preserve portable public vocabulary, and own CI interpreter coverage and its repository instructions.
responsibilities: install the packaged skill into a skills directory, or check an installed copy
run the complete pilot tests on Ubuntu Python 3.13 while retaining the complete legacy release on Ubuntu Python 3.11 and existing Windows smoke scope
document actual CI coverage in repository instructions without extending public product documentation
side_effects: copies the skill files into the target skills directory

components.summary: Unreleased pilot bootstrap, available only as python -m flowguard.behave; keep package imports lightweight and reject pilot behavior below Python 3.12.
responsibilities: provide standalone pilot help that lists only implemented verbs and reject unsupported Python interpreters before loading pilot behavior
keep the pilot absent from the public CLI, exports, skill and product documentation
guard pilot source against dependence on experiment-specific application names
